headline: Binance Halts Withdrawals After Apparent Hack, Faces Up to $6.3B Loss
summary: Binance has suspended deposits and withdrawals following an apparent hack. The security incident could potentially cause up to $6.3 billion in losses at the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major operational suspensions and potential multi-billion-dollar losses at the exchange pose substantial counterparty and liquidity risks for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: An apparent hack and suspension of operations threaten exchange solvency, user trust, and operating revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A security incident and deposit/withdrawal freeze at the world's largest crypto exchange directly disrupts market liquidity and stokes fears of major losses.
